title: HVAC no-cooling diagnostic handoff
prompt: Create a controlled draft SOP for an HVAC field technician receiving a residential no-cooling call. Do not invent manufacturer diagnostics, refrigerant thresholds, licensing permissions, pricing limits, or local code. Compile dispatch inputs, arrival/site safety checks, diagnostic decision points at a safe general level, evidence, customer communication, approval/escalation boundaries, recovery, handoff, and definition of done.

title: Landscape enhancement change-order workflow
prompt: Create an operational procedure for a landscaping crew lead who discovers customer-requested scope expansion during an enhancement job. Include decision rights, estimate/change-order approval boundary placeholders, crew/customer communication, evidence, schedule/material impact, stop/escalate conditions, handoff, and completion evidence without inventing dollar limits.

title: Plumbing inaccessible shutoff exception
prompt: Create a controlled draft field-service SOP for a plumbing technician who cannot access the expected shutoff. Keep technical execution at a safe general level; define stop conditions, property/customer communication, supervisor escalation, evidence, authorization boundaries, containment, rescheduling/handoff, and definition of done.

title: Production deployment runbook
prompt: Create a production-deployment runbook for a SaaS engineering team with readiness criteria, test evidence, change approval, feature flag/migration decision points, observability, rollback criteria, incident escalation, post-deploy validation, records, and definition of done. Do not invent organization-specific approval roles or SLO thresholds; use explicit placeholders where unknown.

title: Privileged access request workflow
prompt: Create an auditable privileged-access workflow for a software company. Include requester/approver separation, justification, scope/time bounds, identity verification, approval evidence, provisioning, validation, exception handling, revocation/review, handoff, and KPI definitions. Do not invent retention periods or access-policy thresholds.

title: Customer data deletion operations
prompt: Create an operations procedure for a SaaS customer-data deletion request. Distinguish general workflow from legal/contractual requirements that require verification, include identity/authorization checks, system dependencies, backups/derived-data unknowns, approvals, execution evidence, exception handling, customer communication, and closure.

title: Month-end close control procedure
prompt: Create a month-end close procedure for a small company. Include close trigger, prerequisites, reconciliation ownership, preparer/reviewer separation where material, journal-entry approval boundaries, exception handling, evidence, handoff, definition of done, and reproducible KPIs. Do not invent materiality thresholds or retention periods.

title: Vendor onboarding and payment control
prompt: Create a vendor onboarding-to-first-payment control procedure with decision rights, segregation of duties, bank-detail verification, approval boundaries, evidence, exceptions, duplicate/fraud risk checks, handoff, and KPI governance. Do not invent spending limits or banking verification methods as authoritative policy.

title: Collections dispute escalation
prompt: Create an accounts-receivable collections/dispute procedure that distinguishes routine contact from disputed balance resolution, approval-required adjustments, evidence, customer communication, escalation, recovery, closure, and metrics. Do not invent legal collection requirements or write-off limits.

title: Clinical intake routing draft
prompt: Create a controlled draft patient/client intake routing procedure for a healthcare service. Do not provide clinical diagnosis or invent medical/legal requirements. Define identity/intake information handling, urgent-risk escalation to qualified clinical staff, privacy-sensitive evidence, incomplete-information paths, handoff acceptance, and authority classification.

title: Food safety deviation workflow
prompt: Create a high-level controlled deviation/hold/escalation workflow for a food operation when a required safety check fails. Do not invent regulatory temperatures, hold times, or disposal rules. Separate verified external requirements from organization procedures, define stop/containment, evidence, competent-authority review, disposition approval, records, and restart criteria.

title: Electrical scope boundary procedure
prompt: Create a controlled draft procedure for a home-service coordinator assigning electrical work. Do not invent licensing law or technical electrical steps. Define job classification, credential/scope verification requirement, assignment authority, stop/escalate path, customer communication, evidence, and handoff.

title: Warehouse damaged-goods exception
prompt: Create a warehouse damaged-goods exception procedure with detection, containment, inventory/system record, ownership, disposition approval boundary, customer/order impact, evidence, recovery, handoff, and metrics. Do not invent financial write-off thresholds.

title: Restaurant opening readiness
prompt: Create an opening-readiness procedure for a restaurant manager. Cover staffing, systems, facility/food-safety readiness at a non-regulatory general level, exception/escalation, customer-impacting outages, evidence, handoff, and definition of done. Any exact health-code requirement must remain source-dependent.

title: Hotel room out-of-service workflow
prompt: Create an operations workflow for marking a hotel room out of service, coordinating maintenance/housekeeping/front desk, guest-impact handling, authority boundaries, evidence, return-to-service checks, handoff, and KPIs without inventing compensation limits.

title: Client deliverable quality release
prompt: Create a professional-services deliverable release SOP with scope/acceptance criteria, reviewer/approver, source verification, version control, confidentiality checks, exception handling, client communication, evidence, and definition of done.

title: Public records request routing draft
prompt: Create a general operations draft for receiving and routing a public-records request. Do not invent jurisdictional deadlines, exemptions, fees, or legal advice. Separate administrative intake from legal/records authority, define evidence, ownership, escalation, communication placeholders, and closure.

title: Security alert triage workflow
prompt: Create a controlled security-alert triage workflow with severity determination placeholders, evidence preservation, analyst decision rights, containment approval boundaries, escalation, handoff, recovery, and metrics. Do not invent incident thresholds or grant unauthorized response authority.

title: Nonconformance and CAPA handoff
prompt: Create a nonconformance-to-corrective-action workflow that defines detection, containment, record, disposition/approval, root-cause decision, corrective action, verification of effectiveness, closure evidence, escalation, and metric definitions without inventing regulated requirements.

title: KPI operating review system
prompt: Create an operating review procedure that converts a list of KPIs into governed metrics with formulas or explicit unknowns, owners, source systems, target provenance, review cadence, variance triage, action owners, balancing metrics, handoff, and closure. Never fabricate targets.
